points.description: Names the two phases: slow start and congestion avoidance (both needed).
Slow start (cwnd < ss_thresh): cwnd grows exponentially (increase by 1 per ACKed segment, i.e. doubling each RTT) until ss_thresh is reached (then switches to congestion avoidance) or loss occurs.
Congestion avoidance (cwnd >= ss_thresh): cwnd grows slowly/linearly (e.g. +1 per RTT, after all segments of the window are acknowledged).
On packet loss/congestion (in either phase): ss_thresh is set to cwnd/2 and cwnd is reset to 1 (back to slow start). Both parts required; ss_thresh otherwise unchanged during normal growth.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both phase names, exponential growth in slow start, linear growth in congestion avoidance, and the loss reaction (ss_thresh = cwnd/2, cwnd = 1). Award each point independently; equivalent wording is accepted. Reduce marks for missing or wrong growth types, or missing loss reaction.
